heading: Ward care
description: The patients now on the wards. Open one to chart vital signs.

errors.systolic: Systolic pressure is a whole number from 40 to 300.
errors.diastolic: Diastolic pressure is a whole number from 20 to 200.
errors.pulse: Pulse is a whole number from 20 to 300.
errors.temperature: Temperature is from 25 to 45, with at most one decimal.
errors.spo2: SpO2 is a whole number from 50 to 100.
errors.pressurePair: Enter systolic and diastolic pressure together.
errors.pressureOrder: Diastolic pressure must be lower than systolic.

done.corrected: Correction saved. The earlier reading is kept.

refused.notOpen: This patient is no longer admitted, so nothing can be recorded.

score.heading: Early warning score

advice.attention: Tell the nurse in charge and check again soon.
advice.urgent: Ask a doctor to review the patient now.

score.worsening: The score is rising across the latest readings.
score.note: Scored from blood pressure, pulse, temperature and SpO2 with the hospital's bands. Respiratory rate and consciousness are not charted, so use clinical judgement.
